seeded from recovery/RELEASES.json's earned loader_ranges (live disassembly evidence, never NOTES.md prose): cassette-buffer / Datasette-buffer region (TBUFFR, $033C-$03FB per the C64 memory map), a classic loader-stub location; holds stale $01-byte data at steady state (not the power-on $00/$FF pattern), i.e. leftover raw-sector-loader scratch never reclaimed by the game. Wider than danish's analogous finding ($0340-$035E, 31 bytes): saeger's uncrunched raw-sector loader leaves a larger scratch footprint here, spanning $0340-$03A0 (97 bytes), before the pattern reverts to ordinary $00 filler at $03A1.
